locations.name: Sound of Luing (named-sea representative)
locations.description: Approximate representative tidal-gate marker for the OS-named Sound of Luing sea feature. It encodes no surveyed gate line, fairway, safe-water position, route, waypoint, exact stream observation, turn, slack, rate, eddy or tidal-race locus.

provenance.warning: OS Open Names supplies a representative point for the broad Sound of Luing Sea feature, not a surveyed gate line, fairway, safe-water position, route, waypoint or exact stream, turn, slack, rate, eddy or tidal-race locus. Its source extent is roughly 3.24 kilometres by 9.50 kilometres and cannot localize the separately described Ardluing, Fladda, Rubha Fiola or Rubha na Lic conditions; consult current official charts and publications before passage planning.
